name: What is the difference between commercial and residential construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between commercial and residential construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary differences between commercial and residential construction lie in their purpose, scale, and regulatory requirements. Residential construction focuses on single-family homes or multi-unit dwellings for habitation, often with simpler designs and building codes. Commercial construction, by contrast, involves structures for business operations, typically larger in scale and more complex. It must adhere to stringent commercial building codes, public safety standards, ADA accessibility guidelines, and specific zoning for business districts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commercial construction builds structures for business use with complex designs and strict commercial codes, while residential focuses on homes with simpler designs and different regulations.
